'''Zack''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] squadron led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nova Stihl]] to respond to the prisoner breakout at [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention block AA-23]] on [[Deck 5|Level 5]] of the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].

==Behind the scenes==
This individual was first named in [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], although there is no indication which trooper he was, as depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].
